headline: Ugro Capital Limited publishes shareholder and creditor meeting notices for scheme of amalgamation
sum: Ugro Capital Limited has intimated the NSE of published shareholder and secured/unsecured creditor meeting notices, signalling progress toward NCLT approval of an amalgamation scheme; full transaction structure and counterparty remain under regulatory seal pending formal scheme filing.
implication: Early-stage scheme announcements via stock exchange intimation precede NCLT jurisdiction filing-monitor for subsequent CCI notification requirements and the formal scheme order timing, which typically follows creditor/shareholder approval by 4–8 weeks.
detail: Ugro Capital Limited, a Mumbai-based non-bank financial institution, has informed the NSE of newspaper publication of notices convening meetings of equity shareholders and both secured and unsecured creditors. This formality is the statutory precursor to scheme circulation and NCLT petitioning under Companies Act ss. 230–232. The target counterparty, merger consideration, and effective date remain confidential pending NCLT review. Shareholder and creditor approval gates the subsequent NCLT application.
